none: PAS NLM-ED0A87: Roman Coin: Barbarous Radiate
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Barbarous radiate issue of 275-285 with two obverse sides [for pro forma recording arbitrarily treated as obv/rev], Reece period 14. Obverse description: Radiate head right. Obverse inscription: [--]AVG. 'Reverse' description: Radiate head right, bearded. Reverse inscription: blundered legend of six characters, probably [---]AVG. Diameter: 11.8mm, Weight: 0.64gms, die axis: 12
